discovery: Initialize, tools/list, resources/list and capabilities inspection are windowless. The first valid workspace request attaches or launches the opted-in GUI. Embedded command metadata is generated from the live registry and parity-tested. Camera arrays have exactly three numeric elements; export array items require kind/index identities. Recursive item validation rejects invalid_argument before handlers or workspace connection.
inspection: List queries filter case-insensitively before pagination and retain record identities. Preview state describes the active viewer; unavailable 3D options are null. Invalid workspace tab requests leave presentation preferences unchanged. Missing structural edit targets return stale_record. Preview capture requires the preview lifetime UUID and returns preview/asset identity; window captures are independent. 3D capture preserves aspect ratio. Explicit camera poses are clamped upright before subsequent movement. MCP shutdown cancels pending jobs and audio retries without owning retained preview lifetimes; canceled animation level refreshes release their loading overlay. Static LOD/horizon/texture-pack and Whole world difficulty refreshes retain the published scene and options until successful replacement; cancellation restores the saved difficulty. Canceled asset/document loading retries the still-current GUI selection outside the operation scope; navigation/disposal/shutdown suppress obsolete recovery. Superseded MCP scene refreshes report context_changed; failed preparation reports preview_unavailable, with no unpublished preview result. Malformed keyframe payloads retain available property fields and a read-only diagnostic at segment 0.
